##: Installer Type: NSIS; extracts the application payload without running the vendor installer.
description: Local semantic search for files by their contents, including documents, images, audio, video, and code.

pre_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'DigUp.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'DigUp.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'helper\digup.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'helper\digup.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }

notes: The Windows build is beta and the installer is unsigned.
The first launch downloads an approximately 865 MB model. The model and index are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\DigUp, outside the Scoop version directory.
